title: Oracle Host Initial Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine with $M.k$ ordinary work tapes, and let $C$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with $C.k>0$. Choose states $en$ and $ex$ of $C$, a Boolean input word $x$, and a family $w$ of Boolean words indexed by the $M.k+1$ tapes of $M$; assume the query-tape word is empty. Starting with the host machine's initial state, its first $M.k+1$ tapes loaded with the corresponding words of $w$ and its other tapes blank, after two steps the machine is in the stable configuration obtained from $M$'s initial configuration on input $x$ with tape words $w$ and side tag true.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine
$C$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$w$ assigns a Boolean word to each of the $M.k+1$ tapes
the query-tape word in $w$ is empty
